coaching.team: This was a game of won fights left on the table: 5.4, 15.9, 20.8, 24.9 and 32.4 were all victories that never became towers, while their two big wins — the 1-4 at their Fangtooth at 17.5 and the 0-4 at Orb Prime at 27 — bought Fangtooth at 19, Orb Prime at 28 and the Genesis Core at 30. coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 0-4 at their Orb Prime at 27 — started while our winning carry stayed in lane — handed over Orb Prime and the Genesis Core, and the 2-5 in our own half at 37.1 finished it.

loadout.name: Kinetic Waltz
loadout.text: Axiom Strike deals 90% damage, has 30% reduced cooldown and grants 35% movement speed for 1.5s when damaging Enemy Heroes.

loadout.name: Marrow
loadout.text: Heal for 6%/7%/8%/9% of damage dealt to Heroes, increased up to 15%/20%/25%/30% based on your Missing Health. (65% effectiveness for AoE attacks, 15% against monsters.)

loadout.name: Blood Bank
loadout.text: Store 100% of Hero damage as charges for 3s. Gain 0.75% Lifesteal per 100 charges.

loadout.name: Jealousy
loadout.text: Deal 1%-8% increased damage as your Health falls from 100% to 20%.
loadout.plain: You deal more damage as your health drops. Pairs with melee stance healing: you can dive in, trade down, and hit harder while the heal brings you back.

loadout.plain: A burst of attack speed, healing on all damage, and extra on-hit damage for 6s. Eden turns attack speed into physical power, so this spikes both her speed and her hit strength in a fight.

Unstoppable Force at rank 3: 105s base, about 80.8s by the end (23% shorter) from 30 ability haste: Void Helm 10, Gaia Greaves 10, Inquisition 10.
Terra dealt 40,715 hero damage, 21% of their team's, with +0 physical power from items.
Cursed Scroll (item): On Basic Attack: Deal 20 (+3.5%) Damage to yourself and the Enemy Target. This damage cannot hurt you below 35% Health.
Fire Blossom (item): Burn nearby Enemy Units: Deals 15 (+1%) Damage each second.Firestorm - When Heatwave damages a Target: Deals 5% more damage each second, up to 40%.
Gaia Greaves (item): Move to generate up to 100 stacks: Stacks grant up to 40 Movement Speed. Basic Attacks expend all stacks for bonus Damage. Deals up to 40 (+60%)(+5%) Damage.
Inquisition (item): On Ability Cast: Emit a wave of energy. Deals 65 (+1.5%) Damage to Enemies in the area. Damage is increased by 45% against Monsters.

Saphir's Mantle (crest): Increase your Size and Max Health by 10% for 6s. Deal 60 (+1.25%) Damage to nearby Heroes. After the duration, permanently increase your Max Health by 20% of the Damage dealt.
Mending (Eternal minor): After taking Hero damage, restore 3/4/5/6% Missing Health at Levels 1/6/11/16 over 8s.
Iron Resolve (augment): Wild Rush grants 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% Damage Reduction while it is Channeling.
Sustain: Void Helm: Heal 20% more from all sources.; 12,830 healing recorded.
Toughness: +1505 health, +148 physical armor, +120 magical armor; took 55,642 damage, mitigated 108,735, died 4 times.

Loadout augment Iron Resolve: Take much less damage while charging Wild Rush. You can safely hold the charge for full range and damage before dashing in. (game text: Wild Rush grants 25/27.5/30/32.5/35% Damage Reduction while it is Channeling.) (changes Wild Rush, 10.8s cooldown with their haste) Field: 48.9% in 2016 games, 52% of picks, above the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout Eternal Idrisil: Extra armor while healthy, then dropping low trades it for a shield based on your armor. Terra stacks armor from her ult, so the shield is large. (game text: While off cooldown and above 30% Max Health, gain 15% increased Physical and Magical Armor. Falling below 30% Health consumes this bonus to grant a 4s Shield equal to 150% of your total Armor (CD: 75–32.5s).) Field: 48.1% in 1560 games, 40% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout minor Mending: After taking hero damage, slowly restores missing health. Fits Terra's job of soaking damage up front. (game text: After taking Hero damage, restore 3/4/5/6% Missing Health at Levels 1/6/11/16 over 8s.) Field: 46.4% in 921 games, 59% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout minor Icy Touch: Your basic attacks lower the enemy's attack speed. Helps Terra win duels against attack-based heroes. (game text: Your Basic Attacks reduce enemy Attack Speed by 3% for 3s (stacks 4x).) Field: 48.4% in 548 games, 35% of picks, above the hero-role's 47.2%.

Loadout crest Saphir's Mantle: Grow bigger and tankier while damaging nearby heroes, then keep some max health permanently. Pop it in the middle of a brawl. (game text: Atlas:  Increase your Size and Max Health by 10% for 6s. Deal 60 (+1.25%) Damage to nearby Heroes. After the duration, permanently increase your Max Health by 20% of the Damage dealt.) Field: 46.7% in 805 games, 21% of picks, level the hero-role's 47.2%.

Stack (Kept alive in fights): 4 effects on one trigger: Saphir's Mantle, Idrisil, Mending, Iron Resolve. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Cursed Scroll, Gaia Greaves, Icy Touch.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 2 effects on one trigger: Cursed Scroll, Idrisil. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.

The Eternal was part of it: Idrisil (Mending + Icy Touch) sits on the same triggers as the items (kept alive in fights; every basic attack set off; finishing damage on low-health targets), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.
Countered? 0 of the 2 players Terra killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Iggy & Scorch, Steel, Aurora. We killed Terra 4 times.
Copy it? Idrisil (Mending + Icy Touch): 46.9% in 258 Terra offlane games, level with the hero's 47.2%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.
